msg: I tried several different ways to work out which gnomes awarded the highest number of mushrooms.  They were as follows:-1. Differentiate between the colours, which colour 'paid' the highest?2. Differentiate between the hat sizes.  At one point I thought the ones with the taller hats paid the most but I don't think that was correct as sometimes the  ones with the smaller hats paid out higher.3. Work out the colour combinations.  I tried to remember for specific colour combinations e.g. one green gnome and one purple gnome which one of them would pay out the highest each time.  To be honest I found this pretty difficult and it's not made any easier by the time constraint of 1.5 seconds.  I think this would probably work if you had more time but you don't so that's really a moot point.4. I then went one further and tried to work out not only the colour combinations but which side of the screen the gnomes were on so for example if you had a green gnome on the left and a purple gnome on the right would the green gnome (for example) pay out the most in that scenario...or...if the purple gnome was on the left and the green gnome on the right is that the scenario in which the green gnome would pay out the most?  Confusing right?!  Needless to say I managed to thoroughly confuse myself with this and it wouldn't really be something so convoluted would it?5. I then decided that it must be just the position the gnomes appeared in on the screen that would determine their payout but that didn't seem to be the case either.6. The only other thing that I could think of was the link between each specific gnome and the forest you ended up in, however, given that you don't see which forest you will be in until after you have selected your gnome that would require some pretty awesome mental gymnastics trying to remember which gnome and forest combination paid out the most mushrooms.  Like I mentioned before the time constraint is a factor hereWishing you the best of luck with it.
